external_anchor.definition: An irreversible, external validation layer that cannot be influenced by the system itself.
external_anchor.principle: No scientific system can validate its own universality claim without an external, uncontrolled reference.
requirements: Data must originate from independent, globally recognized sources
Test protocols must be reproducible outside the repository
Results must be falsifiable by third-party systems
No internal parameter tuning allowed after data exposure

success_condition.description: System demonstrates consistent advantage over baseline models across independent datasets

failure_condition.description: System fails to generalize or shows no advantage over baseline
